name: com.alkaratr/store-mcp
title: AL-KARA Cosmetics & GCC Store MCP Server
description: Search 64+ ÜTS-verified Turkish & Arabic cosmetics, TRY prices, and GCC shipping on alkaratr.com.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search AL-KARA bilingual (Turkish & Arabic) cosmetics & personal care catalog with TRY prices, stock, GTIN barcodes, and GCC air-cargo eligibility.

query.description: Keyword in Turkish, Arabic, English, SKU, or GTIN barcode

brand.description: Brand filter (e.g. Bee Beauty, Dalin, SKIN1004, Morfose, Maybelline)

in_stock_only.description: Only return products currently in stock (default: true)

gulf_only.description: Only products eligible for GCC air cargo (SA, AE, QA, KW, BH, OM)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching products to return (1-25, default: 8)

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full product details (title, short description, TRY price, ÜTS barcode verification, FAQ, safety notes, shipping & return policies) by ID, SKU, GTIN, slug, or title.

identifier.description: Product ID, SKU, GTIN/barcode, URL slug, or partial title

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get canonical AL-KARA store metadata, legal registration (BASMA GLOBAL LOJİSTİK LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ), Türkiye & GCC shipping policies, PayTR payment rules, and optional llms.txt markdown summary.

include_llms_markdown.description: Include full llms.txt markdown summary in response (default: false)

language.description: Response language: 'tr' for Turkish or 'ar' for Arabic (default: 'tr')

tools.name: check_gulf_shipping
tools.description: Verify GCC air-shipping eligibility (SA, AE, QA, KW, BH, OM) via BASMA Global & SMSA Express (4-7 business days) and flag restricted items (colognes, perfumes, acetone, aerosols).

country.description: Destination GCC ISO country code (SA, AE, QA, KW, BH, or OM)

query.description: Optional product name, category, or keyword to check air-cargo eligibility
